blocking.finding: Round-3 blocking #1 (the area-bundle frame) is only half resolved. The plan applies R in `ShipFrame.sky_camera`, but the renderer's own path, `InteriorSky.orient_basis`, is not covered. The `sky_camera` change also breaks `tests/test_physics.gd` check values the plan says stay unchanged. The doc therefore contradicts itself on `interior_golden`.
blocking.evidence: (1) interior/interior_sky.gd:162-167 `orient_basis` multiplies `cam.forward`/`cam.up` by the ship basis directly. For the bundle path, `cam` is cam_<area>.json (interior_sky.gd:41 'cam_<area>.json (ship frame)'; tools/interior_golden.gd:75, 287). `sky_camera` has only two callers: test_physics.gd:1070-1089 and interior_smoke.gd:91. §D1.6 declares the bundle to be the structure frame and applies R only in `sky_camera` (camera-forward.md:183). interior_sky.gd is in neither §D1.6 nor the §D10 table. So the shipped bundle sky and the Blender-baked plates would come out of register under D-92, with no site, test or capture covering it. (2) tests/test_physics.gd:1066-1090 pins `sky_camera` with literal check values: 'cam_bridge.json forward through the GC-heading basis = (f.z, f.x, f.y)', 0.80532, 0.265126, -0.360150, and the NGP-heading permutation. With R applied inside `sky_camera`, every one of these changes. §D8 (:319) and AC-B3 (:385) claim the physics check values and counts are unchanged, and §D1.6 lists only `test_area_bundle`, `test_interior`, `test_bridge_floor`, m4-smoke and `validate_area` as pinning tests. (3) §D1.3 (:160) says `interior_golden` 'works in a pure ship frame and is unchanged'. Once the bundle is the structure frame, `interior_golden` either gets R in `InteriorSky` and so moves, or it keeps treating the bundle camera as kinematic, which contradicts §D1.6.
blocking.fix: Pick one design and state it. Option A: apply R in `InteriorSky.orient_basis` for bundle cameras (the structure to kinematic conversion in one place) and have `sky_camera` call that same function. Option B: keep the bundle frame as the kinematic frame, re-author the cam JSONs, and drop the 'structure frame' claim. Then add `interior/interior_sky.gd` and `tools/interior_golden.gd` to §D1.6 and §D10. Re-state the test_physics lines 1066-1090 check values (they are changed, or R is applied elsewhere). Say whether `interior_golden` stays byte-identical, and add an AC that proves it (a plate-versus-sky registration case in `make golden` or m4-smoke).

blocking.finding: Round-3 blocking #2 (migration sequencing, 'every commit green') is still unresolved. `tests/test_camera_director.gd` hard-codes the old pole and is not in F1a's migration list, yet F1a changes `aim_dir`, `hole_direction` and `ship_vector`. F1a's check says it ends green with a full `make test`.
blocking.evidence: tests/test_camera_director.gd:589 and :595 use `Vector3.UP * 1000` / `Vector3.UP.rotated(...)` as the forward pole, and :633 sets `hole_override = Vector3.UP.rotated(Vector3.RIGHT, tilt)`. The C2 sky_forward and sky_hole blocks (:606-629, :704-722, :756, :793-810) assert the pole is in frame via `pose.origin + Vector3.UP * 1000`. data/camera/views.json:15 `sky_forward` still has pitch_deg 58 and `yaw_rule: tangent`. The sprint md F1a 'Green' step sets `aim_dir` to the bow (camera-forward-sprint.md:~100), and the doc places `aim_dir` in F1a (§D1.1, :138). But the test-migration list at camera-forward.md:412 and sprint md omits `test_camera_director.gd`, and §D10 (:355) schedules its 'v2 plus a legacy block' in F1b. `camera-test` hangs off `ship-demo-ci` (Makefile:1239), so it is in `make test`. After F1a, the existing Sky-forward view (pitch +58°, now aimed at a horizontal pole) fails its own pole-in-frame checks, and so does every test that uses `hole_override`.
blocking.fix: Either (a) list `test_camera_director.gd` (the C2 sky_forward, sky_hole and Sgr A* blocks) in F1a's same-commit migration and say how the legacy views are re-posed, or (b) keep `aim_dir`/UP as a legacy-only constant in F1a and switch it in F1b with the v2 rig. Then say plainly which commits are red. Also add `camera-test` explicitly to F1a's Check.
